value.rationale: This answers a natural finite descriptive-complexity reconstruction question for three concurrent partitions. Beyond finding a first obstruction, it classifies all 21,205 six-point isomorphism types by C2 with precisely eight doubletons and reveals one fixed 3-variable transversal sentence separating every obstruction. The four name-symmetry orbits and shared 0-versus-2 structural mechanism make the result reusable for finite test suites and the study of logic-variable boundaries; it is not simply a reworded known example.
